mapper.sql: t.ticket_id, t.requester_user_id, t.tenant_id, t.ticket_status, t.title, t.description, t.category, t.priority, t.related_order_id, ta.assignee_user_id, ta.assignee_display_name, t.source, t.confirmation_id, t.idempotency_key, t.request_fingerprint, t.created_trace_id, t.created_at, t.updated_at
FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN ticket_assignments ta ON ta.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND ta.ticket_id = t.ticket_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tickets ( tenant_id, ticket_id, requester_user_id, related_order_id, title, description, category, priority, ticket_status, source, confirmation_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, created_trace_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{ticketId}, #{requesterUserId}, #{relatedOrderId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{ticketStatus}, #{source}, #{confirmationId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{createdTraceId}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO ticket_assignments ( tenant_id, ticket_id, assignee_user_id, assignee_display_name, assigned_by_user_id, assigned_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{ticketId}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{assigneeDisplayName}, #{assignedByUserId}, #{assignedAt}, #{assignedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, tenant_id, ticket_id, event_type, event_payload, operator_type, operator_id, trace_id, created_at FROM ticket_events WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_messages ( tenant_id, message_id, ticket_id, visibility, content, author_type, author_user_id, author_display_name, trace_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{messageId}, #{ticketId}, #{visibility}, #{content}, #{authorType}, #{authorUserId}, #{authorDisplayName}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO ticket_events ( tenant_id, event_id, ticket_id, event_type, event_payload, operator_type, operator_id, trace_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{ticketId}, #{eventType}, #{eventPayload}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt} )
